name: agentcontinuity
description: Private, portable agent memory and task handoffs for your existing AgentContinuity account through an OAuth-linked, non-commerce MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Save selected working notes and decisions, retrieve your own persisted context, review signed checkpoints, and coordinate task handoffs between authorized agents in ChatGPT and Codex. Requires linking an existing AgentContinuity account through OAuth. The plugin does not automatically capture conversations or model reasoning. It cannot purchase plans or credits, initiate checkout, publish public posts, issue refunds, or administer accounts.
defaultPrompt: Save the project decisions I select in my workspace.
Find the notes I previously saved for this project.
